title: What's New: E-Documents ZUGFeRD Format (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction to ZUGFeRD and PDF/A-3 Format
ZUGFeRD Setup Requirements and Email Integration

features.name: ZUGFeRD Format Support
features.description: Support for ZUGFeRD format in Business Central for creating and receiving hybrid e-documents combining PDF and embedded XML for German compliance and interoperability.
caveats: ZUGFeRD is specifically required for German market compliance

features.name: PDF/A-3 Format for Long-term Archival
features.description: PDF/A-3 standard format implementation for long-term archiving of electronic documents with embedded file support, enabling human-readable PDFs with machine-readable XML content.

features.name: Outgoing E-Document Creation via ZUGFeRD
features.description: Sales side functionality to create outgoing e-documents in ZUGFeRD format with PDF report layout containing embedded XML, sent through existing connectors or email.

features.name: Inbound E-Document Processing from ZUGFeRD
features.description: Purchase side functionality to receive and automatically process inbound ZUGFeRD e-documents by extracting embedded XML, creating purchase documents, and attaching PDF for human review.

features.name: Automatic Email Sending for Posted E-Documents
features.description: Automatic email delivery of posted e-documents with post-to-send functionality, available starting from 2.7 version in 2025 release wave 2.
caveats: Available from version 2.7 in 2025 release wave 2
